build_xcit_tiny_segmentation: build a semantic segmentation model using XCiT tiny backbone with FPN decoder on ADE20K
configure_xcit_backbone: configure XCiT backbone with patch size 16, embed dim 192, depth 12, and 4 attention heads
setup_adamw_optimizer: setup AdamW optimizer with learning rate 0.00006, weight decay 0.01, and custom key decay rules
configure_lr_schedule: configure poly learning rate schedule with linear warmup over 1500 iterations on ADE20K dataset
build_fpn_neck: build FPN neck with 192 input channels and 192 output channels for multi-scale feature extraction
